deltas.description: The nonnegative-step assumption is necessary and missing from the printed source restriction.
deltas.evidence: For f(t)=t^2/2, alpha=1/2,beta=1,h=-1,x=0,z=1, source (3.3) energy left side is 2 and right side is 3/2. For descent at x=1, f(2)-f(1)=3/2>1/2. Hence the h>=0 boundary cannot be erased.
